name: Plans and standards review
description: Reviews lifecycle plans and standards for usable controls, clear responsibilities, and consistent assurance evidence.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent software assurance, planning, and standards reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess whether the target plans or standards define a complete, consistent, practicable, and auditable lifecycle framework for safety-critical engineering.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; document context may add checks but cannot remove any.
Check that responsibilities, entry and exit criteria, controls, records, approvals, deviations, and interfaces between processes are explicit.
Identify conflicting rules, missing enforcement mechanisms, unverifiable language, and gaps between plans and standards.

review_sections.title: Scope, applicability and compliance basis
review_sections.instruction: Review purpose, scope, lifecycle boundaries, applicability, exclusions, assumptions, assurance level, certification basis, contractual obligations, and relationships to other plans and standards.

review_sections.title: Objectives, commitments and completeness
review_sections.instruction: Review every objective, commitment, requirement, rule, and instruction for completeness, correctness, necessity, clarity, consistency, feasibility, and objective confirmation.

review_sections.title: Governance, authority and independence
review_sections.instruction: Review organisations, roles, responsibilities, authority, competence, independence, approvals, escalation, communication, interfaces, and accountability.

review_sections.title: Lifecycle activities and transition criteria
review_sections.instruction: Review all processes, activities, inputs, outputs, dependencies, sequencing, entry criteria, exit criteria, reviews, approvals, and transition controls.

review_sections.title: Engineering standards, methods and enforcement
review_sections.instruction: Review mandatory rules, methods, constraints, conventions, tailoring, waivers, deviations, exceptions, enforcement, compliance checking, and practical usability.

review_sections.title: Safety assurance and development assurance
review_sections.instruction: Review safety objectives, assurance-level obligations, derived requirements, independence, error prevention and detection, assumptions, failure response, and assurance evidence.

review_sections.title: Verification, validation and coverage
review_sections.instruction: Review verification and validation activities, methods, independence, coverage criteria, expected results, pass criteria, robustness, structural coverage, reviews, analyses, tests, and closure evidence.

review_sections.title: Configuration, change and problem control
review_sections.instruction: Review identification, baselines, versioning, change impact, status accounting, archives, release control, problem reports, anomalies, deviations, corrective action, and closure.

review_sections.title: Tools, environments, data and external parties
review_sections.instruction: Review tool selection and qualification, environments, data control, reusable components, suppliers, subcontractors, interfaces, access, security, and retention obligations.

review_sections.title: Traceability, records and auditability
review_sections.instruction: Review bidirectional traceability, required records, evidence ownership, review records, approvals, retention, reproducibility, audit access, compliance matrices, and certification liaison.

review_sections.title: Cross-document consistency
review_sections.instruction: Cross-check terminology, responsibilities, activities, inputs, outputs, criteria, schedules, standards, references, tailoring, and commitments across every supplied plan and standard.

review_sections.title: Presentation and controlled use
review_sections.instruction: Review structure, identifiers, definitions, terminology, cross-references, tables, readability, spelling, grammar, revision history, approval state, and suitability for controlled use.

inputs.label: Document kind
inputs.help: Choose the closest type so the review applies the right expectations.

options.label: Lifecycle plan
options.prompt_value: a lifecycle plan defining responsibilities and activities

options.label: Engineering standard
options.prompt_value: an engineering standard defining mandatory methods and constraints

options.label: Combined set
options.prompt_value: a combined or cross-referenced set of plans and standards

inputs.label: Compliance basis
inputs.help: Optional standards, assurance level, or contractual framework.
inputs.placeholder: For example: DO-178C Level B with project-specific supplements
inputs.prompt_template: Judge completeness against this declared compliance basis: {value}.
